div.h3: kevnm67/ios-orb — how a consumer pipeline flows through the orb
div.p: Fastlane lanes are the preferred path; raw xcodebuild jobs are the no-Fastfile fallback. v3.4 adds test splitting, DerivedData caching, lint and deploy commands.
